dedupe_keys.name: planar trench geothermal thermal response test february 2023

description: The planar-trench collector team publishes calibrated PT100 temperature measurements from a thermal response test between 28 February and 6 March 2023. The Zenodo deposit provides an observation CSV and a sensor-metadata CSV. Its description records the onset of circulation and heat injection and a constant-volume-flow test setting. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The time series can calibrate ground thermal response and collector operation in shallow-geothermal or building-energy simulations, with model-energyplus offering a related building model. A caveat is that calibrated sensor readings depend on the metadata and calibration assumptions; they should not be merged with later campaigns without time and depth alignment. One test interval does not establish annual heat-pump performance. Own metadata and filenames were checked without downloading rows or fitting thermal parameters. This is a distinct campaign DOI, not a duplicate of the April 2022 deposit.
